NONG VAN SAM
Map-marker-alt Hanoi, Vietnam | Phone-Alt 0384532120 | Envelope samnv.work@gmail.com
Github github.com/donaldsam001 | LINKEDIN Van Sam Nong
SUMMARY
Fourth-year Information Technology student with a strong foundation in Backend Development, specializing in Java and Spring
Boot. Experienced in building RESTful APIs, authentication and authorization using Spring Security, JWT and OAuth2, and
database-driven applications. Hands-on experience with Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Linux, Bash and Networking. Seeking a
part-time Backend Intern position to apply backend development experience while developing skills in CI/CD, containerization,
automation and system operations.
EDUCATION
Hanoi University of Civil Engineering – HUCE 2023–Present
Engineer of Information Technology
GPA: 3.15/4.00
CERTIFICATIONS
TOEIC: 700
TECHNICAL SKILLS
DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, GitLab CI/CD, Git, Linux/Ubuntu, Bash, Networking, CI/CD
Backend: Java, Spring Boot, RESTful API, Spring Security, OAuth2, JWT, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate
Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
Database: MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite
Testing: MockMVC, Testcontainers, Postman
Programming: Java, Python, C/C++, TypeScript
Others: Trello, Antigravity, Codex
PROJECTS
Airline Ticket Sales Platform – Full-Stack Application 2026
• Developed an aviation booking platform using Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs and Next.js, supporting flight search,
booking, passenger management and user account workflows.
• Implemented authentication and role-based authorization using Spring Security and JWT, supporting customer and
administrative access across the application.
• Built authenticated user profile management with Next.js, TypeScript and REST APIs, including personal information
updates, password changes, client-side validation and authentication-state synchronization.
• Designed persistence using MySQL, Spring Data JPA and Hibernate for flights, bookings, passengers, tickets, users and
payment-related data.
• Implemented API and integration testing with MockMVC and Testcontainers and containerized application services using
Docker.
• Practiced deployment and development workflows with Git, GitLab CI/CD, Docker Compose and Linux, troubleshooting
environment variables, networking, ports and service dependencies.
• GitHub: Backend | Frontend
HealCode Telegram – Developer Error Auto-Fix Integration 2026
• Developed an asynchronous Python Telegram bot integrating developers with the HealCode error auto-fix service through
repository registration and automated error-reporting workflows.
• Implemented SQLite persistence with aiosqlite for Telegram identities, chat IDs, repository mappings and HealCode tokens,
including migration support for legacy user data.
• Built a secure repository setup flow supporting GitHub/GitLab HTTPS URL validation, branch configuration and automatic
HealCode token generation.
• Implemented token lifecycle operations including creation, lookup, deletion and chat-based repository/token mapping for
asynchronous error notifications.
• Designed the integration to restore authenticated client sessions and handle expired credentials without interrupting the Telegram
bot workflow.
• Used Python, python-telegram-bot, aiosqlite, REST APIs, Git and environment-based configuration to build an
automation-focused developer tool.
• GitHub: github.com/donaldsam001/healcode-telegram
